learn.hook: A trip to the sabzi market! What will we buy?
points: Mango, banana, apple, guava, papaya and grapes are fruits.
Potato, carrot, spinach, onion, brinjal and cauliflower are vegetables.
Many fruits are sweet and we can eat them raw.
We cook many vegetables to make sabzi, dal or soup.
The mango is the national fruit of India.

example.q: Read: "Pinky goes to the market with Papa. She sees red apples and yellow bananas. Papa buys green spinach and orange carrots. Pinky picks a big mango. "Yum!" she says." Which fruit does Pinky pick?
steps: The story says: Pinky picks a big mango.

learn.reallife: At the market, the fruit seller has mangoes and bananas. The sabzi seller has potatoes and onions.

quiz.explain: A banana is a fruit. Potato and onion are vegetables.

quiz.q: Which is the national fruit of India?
quiz.explain: The mango is the national fruit of India.
quiz.mistake: Does not know the national fruit

quiz.q: Read: "Papa buys green spinach and orange carrots." What colour are the carrots?
quiz.explain: The line says orange carrots. Green tells about the spinach.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up which colour goes with which word

quiz.q: Read: "She sees red apples and yellow bananas." What colour are the bananas?
quiz.mistake: Mixes up which colour goes with which word

quiz.q: 🥭 Which is the right spelling for this fruit?

teach.ask: Gappu: Is a mango a fruit or a vegetable? What about a potato?
teach.praise: Yum! Now I know fruits from vegetables!
teach.nudge: Can you name a fruit and a vegetable?

learn.hook: Want to run fast and grow strong? Eat well!
points: Fruits, vegetables, dal, rice, roti and milk help us grow.
Drink clean water many times a day.
Wash your hands before you eat.
Chips, sweets and cold drinks are fine only once in a while.
Eat slowly and chew your food well.

example.q: Think it through: Ravi wants a healthy snack after school. Should he pick a banana or a big packet of chips?
steps: A banana is a fruit. Fruits help us stay healthy.
Chips have a lot of salt and oil.
So the banana is the healthier snack.

learn.reallife: A good lunch box can have roti, sabzi and a fruit like a guava or an apple.

games.title: Healthy or not? True or false?
items: We should wash our hands before we eat.
Washing hands removes dirt and germs.
Fruits and vegetables help us stay healthy.
Eating chips at every meal is healthy.
Chips have a lot of salt and oil. Eat them only sometimes.
Our body needs water every day.
It is good to gulp food without chewing.
We should chew our food well.

games.title: Every day or once in a while?

quiz.q: What should we do before eating?
quiz.explain: Clean hands keep germs away from our food.
An apple is a fruit. It is a healthy snack.
quiz.mistake: Thinks tasty packaged food is healthy

quiz.q: What should we drink many times a day?
quiz.explain: Our body needs clean water every day.
quiz.mistake: Thinks cold drinks are as good as water

quiz.q: Read: "Meena eats roti, dal and a guava for lunch." Which fruit does Meena eat?
quiz.explain: Guava is the fruit. Roti and dal are not fruits.
quiz.mistake: Picks food that is not a fruit

quiz.q: How should we eat our food?
quiz.explain: Chewing food well helps our body use it.
Healthy food helps our body grow strong.

teach.ask: Gappu: I only want to eat sweets! Is that okay?
teach.praise: Okay! A fruit for me, and a sweet only sometimes!
teach.nudge: What should I eat every day to grow strong?

learn.hook: Do you like karela? Some do, some don't. That is okay!
points: We say "I like ..." for things we enjoy.
We say "I do not like ..." or "I don't like ..." for things we do not enjoy.
We ask "Do you like ...?" to find out.
We answer "Yes, I do." or "No, I don't."

example.q: Read: Asha: "Do you like idli?" Sam: "Yes, I do. I like idli with sambar." Does Sam like idli?

learn.reallife: At a birthday party, friends ask each other, "Do you like cake?"

games.title: Make a sentence
games.prompt: Put the words in order to make a sentence.

quiz.q: Read: "I like grapes. I don't like onions." What does the child like?
Read: "I like grapes. I don't like onions." What does the child not like?
quiz.explain: "I don't like onions" means the child does not enjoy onions.

quiz.q: Your friend asks, "Do you like milk?" You do. What do you say?
quiz.explain: To answer "Do you like...?" with yes, we say "Yes, I do."
quiz.mistake: Uses am instead of do in the short answer

quiz.explain: With I, we say like: I like dosa.

quiz.q: Which word means the same as "do not"?
quiz.explain: Don't is the short form of do not.
quiz.mistake: Does not know the short form don't

quiz.q: Riya does not like karela. What is kind to say?
options: That is okay. I like it.
quiz.explain: People can like different foods. We speak kindly about it.
quiz.mistake: Thinks it is fine to tease others about likes

teach.ask: Gappu: How do I tell my friend what food I like?
teach.praise: I like you! You are a great teacher!
teach.nudge: What do I say for food I do not like?
